articles.summary: Zinc GPT is an open-source AI shopping agent that searches US retailers and completes real checkouts via Stripe and Zinc. Clone the repo or try the live demo.
articles.title: Zinc GPT: Open-Source AI Shopping Agent with Checkout

articles.summary: Use the Zinc API sandbox to build and test ecommerce order integrations with isolated data, test products, and simulated failure scenarios—no real purchases or charges.

articles.title: Order Tracking Across Every Retailer: Automatic Carrier & Tracking Numbers

articles.summary: Order multiple products with quantities in a single API request. Multi-SKU checkout across Amazon, Walmart, Target, and 50+ retailers with Zinc.
articles.title: Multi-Product Ordering API: Order Multiple SKUs Across Retailers at Scale

articles.summary: Get real-time Zinc order webhooks when orders start, place, fail, or receive tracking. Push notifications replace polling for ecommerce order status updates.
articles.title: Zinc Order Webhooks: Real-Time Order Status Updates
